usedFor: Finmei issues your invoices and HubSpot holds your contacts, so “New Invoice Created” can run “Add Notes to Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice Created” in Finmei, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: The invoice shows up as a note on the customer, so sales sees billing in context.

watchOut: “Add Notes to Contact” needs a contact ID or email, so the invoice must carry one.
